svg.text: 32 modules = 32 weeks · one running project "Mini Smart Home" that grows from a blinking LED to an online system
the whole home in Docker Compose: one command on the laptop and on the Pi →
backend and web images (molds), Grafana from files, still on the home network
Module 26 this week (10–12 hours, spread out; the ⭐ path ±9 hours)
Kit B (Raspberry Pi) or a laptop only · Docker Desktop ≥ 4.96.2 or Docker Engine 29 + docker compose · disk ±6 GB · the Module 25 result on main
just-enough Docker & YAML warm-up: your home's
inventory, counters in use, YAML, .env, docker inspect
Quick Win: two services, one command
a practice broker + a sender, service name = address
the workbench and the old data's fingerprint ⭐
a two-stage Dockerfile, .dockerignore, the user node
Caddy serves dist/, /api is forwarded to the backend
the cupboards move: database & Grafana into Compose ⭐
external cupboards, the old password in .env, data intact
the whole home in one command ⭐
central broker, migrate, backend, web: docker compose up -d
the Pi gateway: edge/compose.edge.yml + a bridge ⭐
pass requirement L4 (Kit B); laptop path: the simulator
the takeover: rule → contact point → old data source
coming back to life by itself, data that stays ⭐
pass requirement L3: exec backend kill 1, down then up -d
backing up the cupboards and a restore test
pg_dump → a separate project, the same fingerprint
the image shop: GHCR by hand
docker compose push, a public package, arm64 vs amd64
pass requirements L1, L2, L3: a stopwatch from git clone
Add-on: the whole system wrapped in Docker, pull request
Pass requirement (split of the Syllabus ✅): L1–L4 = the lines you tick in the pass checklist
a clean laptop: from git clone to the Login page in < 10 minutes; write down two numbers (total and without downloads) + your internet speed
the default services are up: db, backend, grafana healthy, mosquitto, web; the one-offs Exited (0)
the same history fingerprint after docker compose down and then docker compose up -d (not down -v)
Kit B: the Pi runs edge/compose.edge.yml; Node 1 connects with its old address and account (firmware unchanged), data live
Laptop path (no Pi): L1 + L2 + L3; the stand-in for L4 = the simulator publishing to the central broker on the laptop, shown live.
split from the Syllabus ✅ sentence: "on a ‘clean’ laptop (or a friend's), git clone + docker compose up -d runs the whole system
in < 10 minutes, and the history data is still there after docker compose down && up." (note in Syllabus v1.0.28: prerequisites don't count, ±1.1 GB download)
Proven in: L1 and L2 Practice 11 · L3 Practices 8 and 11 · L4 Practice 6 · the author's lab (warm): 62.3 s to the Login page
Changed: backend 1.3.0, frontend 1.2.0, grafana/ becomes provisioning files, new compose.cloud.yml + edge/compose.edge.yml.
Unchanged: data contract 1.4, the Node 1 and Node 2 firmware, database migrations 001–010.
Still on the home network: the internet, HTTPS, MQTT TLS, and a bridge that survives outages come in Module 27.
